title: Books, papers, etc.
bodyText: All books, papers, records, and accounts of such person shall at all reasonable times be open to inspection by the director of finance of such county, or the director's agents appointed for such purpose.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: Reference to director of finance substituted for treasurer to conform to county charters pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
§240-2  Books, papers, etc.  All books, papers, records, and accounts of such person shall at all reasonable times be open to inspection by the director of finance of such county, or the director's agents appointed for such purpose. [L 1937, c 105, pt of §1; RL 1945, pt of §5681; RL 1955, §131-2; HRS §240-2; gen ch 1985]

 

Revision Note

 

  Reference to director of finance substituted for treasurer to conform to county charters pursuant to §23G-15.
